chars_per_token.note: range carried from Propuesta-Tokens spec/workload.json; no provider tokenizer was run, and the three providers tokenize Spanish differently

metadata_output_chars.note: the smallest analysis reply measured across the 59 episodes; a title plus description of about 862 chars cannot support the 4,417-char mean of a transcript analysis, so the measured floor is used as the metadata-path output

instruction_overhead_chars.note: the summarizer's fixed instructions plus the 221-char glossary, as sent today

report_output_chars.note: per_unit_synthesis is the mean of the 16 per-show weekly summaries of the week of 26 October; cross_cutting is the week-wide themes reply

scenarios.label: LOW: metadata and descriptions only, no audio leaves the feed
MEDIUM: transcripts for half the episodes, single provider, sampled verification
HIGH: transcripts for every episode, all three providers on every episode, full verification
